# Senior Backend Engineer

Bengaluru, India · Full time · Engineering

## About the role

We are looking for a backend engineer to design and run the APIs behind our payments platform. You will own services end to end, from design reviews to on-call, and work with product and finance teams on reconciliation and reporting.

## What you will do

- Build and operate TypeScript services on PostgreSQL and Kafka
- Improve the reliability and latency of payment flows
- Mentor engineers and review designs

## Requirements

- 5+ years building backend systems
- Experience with distributed systems and relational databases
